A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the simplicial complexities of all surface groups are known, and the simplicial complexes of surface groups are all known to be connected.
the simplicial and systolic complexity of surface groups are completely understood, but their behavior under free product is not.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the simplicial complexities of surface groups are very small.
the simplicial complex of surface groups has a surprisingly simple structure.
